scope: New ordinary BUY / SELL progression through existing foreground and deferred native checks; no payment or broker redemption
decimalEncoding: Unformatted base-10 strings; native BigDecimal calculation; UI projections never feed calculations

sell.feePercentEncoding: sellRateInput is percent; native feeRate is a fraction in [0,1)
sell.fundScope: Only funds mapped from the current synchronized YJB holdings; native fresh GET validates owned baseline and available shares
sell.calculatedProfit: netAmount - requestedShares * baselineUnitCost; local calculation, not confirmed cash receipt
sell.precision: Native account-scoped VerifiedWritePrecision only; no default or inferred maximum. Refuse unchanged rounded targets, accidental partial-to-zero clearance or changed unit cost
sell.quantityProjection: confirmedShares retains requested quantity; SYNCED shareDelta reflects verified submitted remaining shares. Cash calculation uses requested shares and is not an actual cash settlement
sell.storage: Independent app-private Keystore AES-GCM journal; BUY journal and Room schema unchanged

confirmation: Freeze the calendar-supported target NAV valuation date. Match only official history day == target; missing target remains WAITING_NAV even when later dates exist. Unknown fund/year remains unverified; never substitute latest or first later NAV. No user NAV edit.
sync: Local ownership, token, signature and cooldown preflight
Persist frozen target and sending marker immediately before transport dispatch
Persist sanitized write stage/error separately from readback status
GET verify; SYNCED only when target matches
uncertainDelivery: GET before retry: Automatic sync and ordinary sync actions are always GET-only after a sending marker. Baseline readback never proves non-delivery. Aged unresolved records can enter a native review dialog; only explicit confirmation authorizes one recovery POST of the same frozen target, with a new fresh baseline GET, queue ownership guards, durable recovery attempt and GET verification. Other holdings stop as EXTERNAL_CHANGED.
acceptance: Host/fake tests do not establish real SELL acceptance. User-selected, reviewed real transaction and real GET verification required
confirmationDisplay: Actual first NAV confirmation date in Asia/Shanghai. confirmedNavDate remains official NAV belonging date. Legacy missing timestamps are unknown, never inferred from updatedAt or syncedAt.
creationRecovery: Persist one encrypted native request intent and stable UUID before create. Reconcile journals under the transaction gate after restart; only acknowledge a known result. An unknown result never enables a blind second create.
automation: Only new ordinary rows with autoSync=true are automatically checked and synced. Legacy missing autoSync remains manual. Failed/uncertain POST recovery is GET-only; user retry retains fresh baseline/target verification.
fundCatalogue: BUY selects synchronized YJB funds or explicitly registered local zero placeholders. SELL uses nonzero YJB holdings only. Search/addition is a separate guarded capability, never an implicit BUY initialization.
formalNavCache: App-private encrypted formal NAV cache; successful fetch reused for five minutes across restart; older dates retained. Changed value for an existing date fails closed. Never supplies current holdings.

writeDiagnostics.writeStage: Optional NOT_SENT / MAY_HAVE_SENT / ACKNOWLEDGED; legacy absence remains unknown
writeDiagnostics.writeProblem: Sanitized last write failure independent of GET result
writeDiagnostics.recoveryAttempts: Durable timestamps; quotes bound to attempt count prevent replay
writeDiagnostics.reviewAfter: 15 minutes since latest recovery or initial send; legacy uses creation time only for visibility, never infers non-delivery

recoveryCommand: recover-write accepts only transaction id; native derives frozen target, reads current YJB, asks user confirmation, then rechecks before any POST. No browser supplied target or confirmation flag accepted.
